cc:Work.dc:title: Box - BasedBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Fully closed box on a base
This box is more of a building block than a finished item. Use a vector graphics program (like Inkscape) to add holes or adjust the base plate. The width of the "brim" can also be adjusted with the **edge_width** parameter in the **Finger Joints Settings**.
See ClosedBox for variant without a base.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes BasedBox --FingerJoint_style=rectangular --FingerJoint_surroundingspaces=3 --FingerJoint_bottom_lip=0.0 --FingerJoint_edge_width=1.0 --FingerJoint_extra_length=0.0 --FingerJoint_finger=3 --FingerJoint_play=0.0 --FingerJoint_space=3 --FingerJoint_width=1.0 --x=109 --y=109 --h=40 --outside=0 --thickness=3.0 --burn=0.1 --format=svg --labels=0 --labels=1 --reference=100.0 --tabs=0.0 --qr_code=0 --qr_code=1 --inner_corners=loop --spacing=0.5 --debug=0 Command line short: boxes BasedBox --FingerJoint_surroundingspaces=3 --FingerJoint_finger=3 --FingerJoint_space=3 --x=109 --y=109 --h=40 --outside=0 --qr_code=0 --qr_code=1 --spacing=0.5 Url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/BasedBox?FingerJoint_style=rectangular&FingerJoint_surroundingspaces=3&FingerJoint_bottom_lip=0.0&FingerJoint_edge_width=1.0&FingerJoint_extra_length=0.0&FingerJoint_finger=3&FingerJoint_play=0.0&FingerJoint_space=3&FingerJoint_width=1.0&x=109&y=109&h=40&outside=0&thickness=3.0&burn=0.1&format=svg&labels=0&labels=1&reference=100.0&tabs=0.0&qr_code=0&qr_code=1&inner_corners=loop&spacing=0.5&debug=0&language=en&render=2 Url short: http://127.0.0.1:8000/BasedBox?FingerJoint_surroundingspaces=3&FingerJoint_finger=3&FingerJoint_space=3&x=109&y=109&h=40&outside=0&spacing=0.5 SettingsUrl: http://127.0.0.1:8000/BasedBox?FingerJoint_style=rectangular&FingerJoint_surroundingspaces=3&FingerJoint_bottom_lip=0.0&FingerJoint_edge_width=1.0&FingerJoint_extra_length=0.0&FingerJoint_finger=3&FingerJoint_play=0.0&FingerJoint_space=3&FingerJoint_width=1.0&x=109&y=109&h=40&outside=0&thickness=3.0&burn=0.1&format=svg&labels=0&labels=1&reference=100.0&tabs=0.0&qr_code=0&qr_code=1&inner_corners=loop&spacing=0.5&debug=0&language=en&render=2 SettingsUrl short: http://127.0.0.1:8000/BasedBox?FingerJoint_surroundingspaces=3&FingerJoint_finger=3&FingerJoint_space=3&x=109&y=109&h=40&outside=0&spacing=0.5
